metadata.title: Letter by Adivasi girl after her death from an Ashram School | अपनी मौत पर  लड़की कुछ कहना चाहती है
metadata.description:
Parliament standing committee in it's report point out that at least 1500 tribal children have died in Ashram schools. In this report committee has shown concern over the poor hygiene and substandard food served to the tribal children in these schools. This report was placed in the parliament, but nothing changed. A class 7 girl in Kandhmal district was found pregnant and she died while delivering the child. The child was also declared dead. This happened on 5 October 2022. 

It's an effort to highlight the plight of the tribal students in Ashram shool and visuals used in this video are symbolic only. A few of the visuals have been taken from RSTV.
